name: game-04-cinders-ice-rink-chaos.html
title: Cinder's Ice Rink Chaos — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🧊 CINDER'S ICE RINK CHAOS Blaze & Boulder star in this frosty frenzy! Drag an ice block back and release to flick it! Smash every crystal target. Ice is slippery — plan your angles! 💥 The glowing orange Ember Bomb Block blasts every crystal within splash range!

name: game-05-lord-infernos-ballista-siege.html
title: Lord Inferno's Ballista Siege — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🏹 LORD INFERNO'S BALLISTA SIEGE Ruko & Sizzle man the sky-ballista! Drag to steer! Ballista auto-fires — dodge rocks, blast enemies, grab power-ups! ✦ New power-up: Ember Nova — 4-way bolts for 10 seconds!

name: game-06-blazes-magma-bounce.html
title: Blaze's Magma Bounce — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 💥 BLAZE'S MAGMA BOUNCE Boulder & Cinder enter the sumo ring! Fling Blaze to BUMP rock golems out of the arena! Drag back and release. Last one in the ring wins! 🌋 Grab the Magma Surge orb — Blaze's bumps hit 25% harder for 8 seconds! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Hot lava is like a real fire — never touch, always stay back! ▶ PLAY

name: game-07-rukos-turbo-drift.html
title: Ruko's Turbo Drift — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🎵 RUKO'S TURBO DRIFT Sizzle & Lord Inferno drop the beat! Notes fall down 4 lanes — TAP each lane when the note hits the glowing zone! Use D F J K keys or tap the lanes!

name: game-08-sizzles-spark-jump.html
title: Sizzle's Spark Jump — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🦘 SIZZLE'S SPARK JUMP Cinder & Blaze bounce to the stars! Tilt your phone or tap left/right sides to steer — Sizzle auto-bounces! Climb as high as you can. Watch for crumbling platforms! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Always have a grown-up nearby when you climb high! ▶ PLAY

name: game-09-ember-cascade.html
title: Ember Cascade — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🏰 EMBER CASCADE Lord Inferno & Ruko defend the keep! Pick a defender below, then tap a glowing tile to place it! They auto-blast rock invaders marching down 3 lanes. Survive 8 waves! 🔥 Shooter: fast sparks | ❄️ Frost: slows enemies | 💣 Cannon: big splash damage ⚡ New: Storm tower (150🔥) — lightning that chains to a second invader for half damage! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire

name: game-10-caldera-climb.html
title: Caldera Climb — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 💎 CALDERA CLIMB Blaze & Boulder need your matching magic! Swap adjacent ember blocks to match 3+! Match 4 for a line blast , match 5 for a color bomb ! Chain a cascade (x2+) to forge an 🌟 Ember Nova — swap it to blast a 3×3 area! Reach the target score before moves run out!

name: game-11-magma-trench-dodge.html
title: Magma Trench Dodge — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> ⚡ MAGMA TRENCH DODGE Ruko & Sizzle sprint for their lives! TAP anywhere to jump! Tap again mid-air for a double jump ! Dodge lava geysers, grab crystals. Hold for higher jumps! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: When running from danger, look where you're going — don't look back! ▶ PLAY

name: game-12-volcanic-pinball.html
title: Volcanic Pinball — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🎱 VOLCANIC PINBALL Boulder & Cinder hit the arcade! Tap LEFT / RIGHT sides of the screen to flip! Keep the fireball alive, smash bumpers for combos. Hit the 🌟 Nova Bumper (125) to earn a one-time 🛡️ Ember Shield that saves your next drained ball! You have 3 balls! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Pinball is electric fun — never touch real electrical panels! ▶ PLAY

name: game-13-pyra-prime-defense.html
title: Pyra Prime Defense — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🧱 PYRA PRIME DEFENSE Sizzle & Lord Inferno smash the rock wall! Drag or move your mouse to slide the paddle! Bounce the fireball, break every brick. Grab falling power-ups — including the new 💥 Nova Burst , which blasts the 5 bricks nearest your paddle!

name: game-14-sparky-speedway.html
title: Sparky Speedway — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🐍 SPARKY SPEEDWAY Cinder & Blaze leave a trail of embers! Swipe , use the d-pad , or arrow keys to steer! Eat crystals to grow. Don't hit yourself or the walls! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Snakes are cool — but never touch a real one! Tell a grown-up if you see one. ▶ PLAY

name: game-15-cinders-melt-down.html
title: Cinder's Melt-Down — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🃏 CINDER'S MELT-DOWN Lord Inferno & Ruko test your memory! Tap cards to flip two at a time — find all matching Fire Babys pairs! Fewer flips = more stars!

name: game-16-inferno-drop.html
title: Inferno Drop — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🔨 INFERNO DROP Blaze & Boulder need fast fingers! TAP rock moles as they pop from lava holes! Bonk golden moles for bonus. Don't tap fire babies — they're friends! 60 seconds on the clock! Tap the 🔨 mole to grab the Golden Mallet — 5s of +25% points & bigger bonks! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Fast reactions save lives — practice your fire drill! ▶ PLAY

name: game-17-flame-sprint-2d.html
title: Flame Sprint 2D — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🗼 FLAME SPRINT 2D Ruko & Sizzle are stacking a tower to the sky! TAP or press SPACE to drop the sliding block! Line it up — the overhang gets trimmed. Perfect drops build combos. Miss 3 times and it's over! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Build your tower of safety knowledge — one fact at a time! ▶ PLAY

name: game-18-blazes-thermal-run.html
title: Blaze's Thermal Run — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🌀 BLAZE'S THERMAL RUN Boulder & Cinder must escape the lava maze! DRAG the fire baby from the green START to the golden EXIT . Don't touch lava walls — 3 touches and you're out! Faster = bigger score!

name: game-19-rukos-lava-leap.html
title: Ruko's Lava Leap — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🫧 RUKO'S LAVA LEAP Sizzle & Lord Inferno need a sharpshooter! DRAG to aim, RELEASE to fire! Match 3+ bubbles of the same color to pop them. Stranded bubbles fall! Tap the shooter to swap colors. Every 6 shots charges an Ember Bomb — press B to arm it; it pops up to 3 extra bubbles!

name: game-20-boulders-fortress.html
title: Boulder's Fortress — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🪨 BOULDER'S FORTRESS Cinder & Blaze are flying through the crystal fortress! TAP or press SPACE to flap! Glide through crystal gates — don't touch anything. It gets faster! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Flying is fun in games — in real life, stay grounded during storms! ▶ PLAY

name: game-21-sizzles-target-pop.html
title: Sizzle's Target Pop — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🧩 SIZZLE'S TARGET POP Lord Inferno & Ruko dropped their volcano picture — oh no! DRAG each puzzle piece into its glowing slot! Drop it close and it snaps in. Finish fast for a bigger score!

name: game-22-magma-block-breaker.html
title: Magma Block Breaker — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🧱 MAGMA BLOCK BREAKER Magma blocks are raining down! TAP each block to smash it before it hits the lava! Don't tap the ice blocks — they're friendly! Golden blocks are worth 5x! Tap the 💥 Ember Nova block to blast nearby magma blocks (base points, no combo)! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: If something hot is falling, move away — don't try to catch it! ▶ PLAY

name: game-23-crater-catcher.html
title: Crater Catcher — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🧺 CRATER CATCHER Stars are falling from the sky! DRAG or move your mouse to slide the basket! Catch stars , avoid meteors ! Golden stars are worth 5x! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Catch good habits — always catch yourself before you fall! ▶ PLAY

name: game-24-ash-storm-survivor.html
title: Ash Storm Survivor — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🌪️ ASH STORM SURVIVOR The ash storm is coming! DRAG or use WASD/arrows to move! Your fire baby auto-blasts nearby enemies. Collect XP gems, level up, choose upgrades. Survive as long as you can! Level-up can unlock 💥 Ember Nova — a periodic blast that damages every ash fiend nearby. 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: In a real storm, get inside and stay away from windows!

name: game-25-lava-line-draw.html
title: Lava Line Draw — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> ✏️ LAVA LINE DRAW Guide the little fire baby home! DRAW lines with your finger to make ramps and bridges! Then tap ▶ GO to roll the fire baby to the golden goal. You have limited ink — plan wisely!

name: game-26-pyra-paddle-battle.html
title: Pyra Paddle Battle — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🏓 PYRA PADDLE BATTLE It's you vs. the machine! DRAG or move your mouse to slide your paddle! First to 7 points wins. Watch for speed boosts and curve balls! Every 4th paddle hit is a 🔥 Flame Surge shot (+25% ball speed)! 😊 Easy 😐 Medium 😈 Hard

name: game-27-ember-bounce-2d.html
title: Ember Bounce 2D — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🦘 EMBER BOUNCE 2D Bounce to the sky! TILT (drag left/right) or use arrow keys to steer! Land on platforms to bounce higher. Green = normal, blue = moving, red = breakable , gold = super bounce! How high can you go? 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Bounce back from mistakes — always learn fire safety! ▶ PLAY

name: game-28-thermal-tug-of-war.html
title: Thermal Tug-of-War — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🪢 THERMAL TUG-OF-WAR It's a pulling contest! TAP AS FAST AS YOU CAN anywhere to pull the rope! Drag the flag past YOUR line to win the round. Best of 3 rounds wins the match! ⚓ EMBER ANCHOR: taps charge the meter — at 20, press SPACE for a big Anchor Slam pull! 😊 Easy 😐 Medium 😈 Hard

name: game-29-blazes-jump-quest.html
title: Blaze's Jump Quest — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🏃 BLAZE'S JUMP QUEST Run to the flag! TAP RIGHT SIDE or press → to run, TAP LEFT SIDE / SPACE to jump! Stomp enemies from above, grab all coins, reach the 🏁 flag! 🔥 EMBER BLASTER: press F to shoot a fireball (same 100 pts as a stomp)!

name: game-30-rukos-dash-blitz.html
title: Ruko's Dash Blitz — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> ⚡ RUKO'S DASH BLITZ Run as fast as you can! TAP or press SPACE to jump! SWIPE DOWN / S to slide! Dodge rocks, jump gaps, slide under barriers. Grab ⚡ for a dash boost! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: When escaping fire, stay low and move fast! ▶ PLAY

name: game-31-boulders-rampart.html
title: Boulder's Rampart — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🏰 BOULDER'S RAMPART Defend the castle! TAP a tower type, then TAP the battlefield to build it! Enemies march left to the castle. 🏹 fast, 💣 splash damage, ❄️ slows enemies, 🔥 Ember sets enemies ablaze (burn damage over time). Survive all 10 waves! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Defend your home — keep exits clear! ▶ PLAY

name: game-32-cinders-glide.html
title: Cinder's Glide — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🪂 CINDER'S GLIDE Glide through the crystal caves! HOLD (touch or SPACE) to rise, RELEASE to dive! Thread the gaps between stalactites. Grab 💎 gems for bonus points! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Glide to safety — stay calm and move steadily! ▶ PLAY

name: game-33-inferno-aim.html
title: Inferno Aim — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🎯 INFERNO AIM How sharp is your aim? TAP targets to blast them! Don't hit the 💣 bombs (-50 pts)! Golden targets are worth 5x. You have 60 seconds — bullseyes give bonus time! Rare 💥 Nova Stars burst every other target on screen for bonus points! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Aim for safety — always point away from fires! ▶ PLAY

name: game-34-spark-jump-arcade.html
title: Spark Jump Arcade — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🦘 SPARK JUMP ARCADE One tap, perfect timing! TAP to jump to the next platform! Land in the green zone for a PERFECT (+3 pts)! Platforms shrink and move faster as you go. Don't fall! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Perfect landings take practice — practice fire safety! ▶ PLAY

name: game-35-lava-moat-defense.html
title: Lava Moat Defense — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🌋 LAVA MOAT DEFENSE They're coming from EVERYWHERE! TAP anywhere on the lava moat ring to build a fire tower (50 🪙)! Towers auto-blast enemies marching toward the castle. Rotate your defense — survive all 12 waves! 🔆 EMBER NOVA BLAST: every 12 tower kills charges a Nova — tap the castle or press SPACE to blast all nearby enemies for 45 damage! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Sa

name: game-36-magma-drop-physics.html
title: Magma Drop Physics — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🔮 MAGMA DROP PHYSICS Drop the magma ball! TAP anywhere at the top to drop a ball! It bounces through pegs into multiplier slots. Chain bumper hits for combo points. 10 balls — rack up the biggest score!

name: game-37-volcanic-stack-smash.html
title: Volcanic Stack Smash — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🏗️ VOLCANIC STACK SMASH Build the tallest tower! TAP to drop each swinging block onto the stack! Overhang gets smashed off . Land perfectly centered for a PERFECT (block grows back)! How high can you build? 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Build strong habits — stack up your safety knowledge! ▶ PLAY

name: game-38-fire-baby-rally.html
title: Fire Baby Rally — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🏁 FIRE BABY RALLY 3 laps — beat the clock! HOLD to accelerate, ◀ ▶ or arrow keys to steer! Stay on the track — grass slows you down. Hit the boost pads for speed! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Race to safety — never race real cars! ▶ PLAY

name: game-39-caldera-bounce.html
title: Caldera Bounce — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🎈 CALDERA BOUNCE Bounce to the top! DRAG the paddle to bounce the ball upward! Break all the blocks to clear the level. Don't let the ball fall past your paddle! 💥 BLAST BALL: every 6th block you break drops a glowing pickup — catch it with your paddle for 6 seconds of double brick damage!

name: game-40-sizzles-spark-run.html
title: Sizzle's Spark Run — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> ✨ SIZZLE'S SPARK RUN Collect the sparks! SWIPE or use ◀ ▶ to switch lanes, SWIPE UP / SPACE to jump! Grab ✨ sparks, dodge 🪨 rocks and 🔥 fire walls. Chain sparks for combo points! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Collect good habits — dodge danger! ▶ PLAY

name: game-41-blazes-inferno-roll.html
title: Blaze's Inferno Roll — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🔥 BLAZE'S INFERNO ROLL Roll to the goal! DRAG anywhere to tilt the maze, or use arrow keys/WASD ! Roll the fireball through the maze, collect all ⭐ stars, then reach the 🏁 goal. Avoid the lava pits!

name: game-42-rukos-speed-trap.html
title: Ruko's Speed Trap — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> ⚡ RUKO'S SPEED TRAP Lightning-fast reactions! TAP (or press SPACE ) when the sweeping needle hits the green zone ! Perfect center = JACKPOT. 10 rounds — the needle gets faster every round. Miss and you lose points! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: React fast — but always think first! ▶ PLAY

name: game-43-boulders-blockade.html
title: Boulder's Blockade — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🧱 BOULDER'S BLOCKADE Clear the path! DRAG blocks to slide them! Horizontal blocks move ↔️, vertical blocks move ↕️. Clear a path so the 🔥 fireball can roll to the 🏁 goal. Fewest moves = most stars!

name: game-44-cinders-slide.html
title: Cinder's Slide — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🧩 CINDER'S SLIDE Slide the picture back together! TAP a tile next to the empty space to slide it! Rebuild the fire baby picture. Bigger grids = bigger challenge!

name: game-45-lord-infernos-strike.html
title: Lord Inferno's Strike — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> ⚡ LORD INFERNO'S STRIKE Command the storm! TAP anywhere to call down a lightning strike! Zap the ash monsters before they reach your castle. Each strike costs mana — it refills over time. Chain lightning hits nearby enemies! Earn a 🔆 Inferno Nova every 6 zaps — press SPACE / X to blast the most advanced monster for 55 damage! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Lightning is

name: game-46-magma-jump-2d.html
title: Magma Jump 2D — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🧗 MAGMA JUMP 2D Wall-jump to the sky! TAP to jump to the opposite wall! Time it right to grab ⭐ stars. Avoid the 🔥 lava patches on the walls. Don't fall below the screen! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Climb to safety — know your exits! ▶ PLAY

name: game-47-pyra-prime-dash.html
title: Pyra Prime Dash — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 💨 PYRA PRIME DASH Thread every gate! DRAG left/right (or ◀ ▶ ) to steer! Fly through the glowing gates — miss one and you lose a life. 3 lives, 20 gates. Golden gates are worth 3x! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Dash to safety — know your exits! ▶ PLAY

name: game-48-ash-heap-hero.html
title: Ash Heap Hero — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🦸 ASH HEAP HERO Clean up the ash heap! DRAG each falling item into the correct bin! 🔥 Burnables, ♻️ Recyclables, 🗑️ Trash. Sort fast — wrong bin loses points! 90 seconds on the clock! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Be a hero — keep your home clean and safe! ▶ PLAY

name: game-49-thermal-track.html
title: Thermal Track — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🛤️ THERMAL TRACK Stay on the track! DRAG your finger along the glowing track from 🟢 START to 🏁 FINISH! Go off the track 3 times and it's over. Faster = more points!

name: game-50-ember-bounce-master.html
title: Ember Bounce Master — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🔥 EMBER BOUNCE MASTER Bounce to the top! DRAG or use ◀ ▶ to move the paddle! Bounce the ember up, smash every brick, and grab the ⭐ bonus stars. Angle your shots — steeper angles climb faster! Broken bricks sometimes drop a 🔥 Splitter Core — catch it with your paddle and your ember PIERCES straight through bricks for 5 seconds!

name: game-51-volcanic-target.html
title: Volcanic Target — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🎯 VOLCANIC TARGET Hit every target! TAP targets before they vanish! Bullseyes = big points, golden = jackpot. Watch out — decoys cost you! Rare 💣 Magma Bombs clear every other target on screen for base points! 60 seconds, targets get faster! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Aim for safety — hit the right target! ▶ PLAY

name: game-52-lava-rush-arcade.html
title: Lava Rush Arcade — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🌋 LAVA RUSH ARCADE Outrun the lava! TAP / SPACE to jump! SWIPE DOWN to slide! Dodge lava geysers and rock walls. Grab ⭐ for points. How far can you rush? 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Run from danger — never toward it! ▶ PLAY

name: game-53-flame-drop-physics.html
title: Flame Drop Physics — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 💧 FLAME DROP PHYSICS Guide the falling flame! TAP DROP to release, then DRAW ramps (📐) to steer, place fans (💨) to push! Get the flame to the 🏁 goal — avoid the 💧 water drops!

name: game-54-blazes-zenith.html
title: Blaze's Zenith — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> ⛰️ BLAZE'S ZENITH Climb the volcano! TAP LEFT/RIGHT side of screen (or ◀ ▶ ) to hop between platforms! Grab ⭐, avoid 🪨 crumbling rocks. Reach the peak flag 4 times!

name: game-55-rukos-final-dash.html
title: Ruko's Final Dash — by Jman350Z & fire team
overlay_text: id="overlay"> 🔥 RUKO'S FINAL DASH The grand finale! TAP to dash-attack the bosses! SWIPE / ◀ ▶ to dodge their fireballs! 3 bosses, 3 lives. Hit them when they're open — dodge when they glow! 🔥 NEW — Ember Combo Charm: every 4th hit deals DOUBLE damage! 🔒 Parental Gate 3 + 4 = UNLOCK 🔥 Fire Safety: Face danger smart — dodge, don't freeze! ▶ PLAY
